column1: The official DAB container image repository is {{c1::mcr.microsoft.com/azure-databases/data-api-builder}}.
column2:
Add the image tag for the DAB version that you intend to deploy.
Review source

column1: In a DAB Linux Dockerfile, {{c1::COPY dab-config.json /App/dab-config.json}} packages the API configuration.
column2:
Keep literal credentials out of the copied file and supply them securely at runtime.
Review source

column1: For DAB listening on container port 5000, set Container Apps ingress with {{c1::--target-port 5000}}.
column2:
The ingress target port must match the port that the container actually serves.
Review source

column1: In az containerapp create, expose the DAB app through public ingress with {{c1::--ingress external}}.
column2:
Public network reachability does not replace API authentication and authorization.
Review source

column1: For an existing Container Apps secret named database-conn, reference its value in --env-vars with {{c1::DATABASE_CONNECTION_STRING=secretref:database-conn}}.
column2:
This injects the secret into the container's environment instead of embedding it in the image.
Review source

column1: An App Service Key Vault reference uses {{c1::@Microsoft.KeyVault}}(SecretUri=secret-uri) as an app setting value.
column2:
Replace secret-uri with the full HTTPS secret URI. App Service resolves the reference using its configured identity.
Review source

column1: For Azure SQL system-assigned managed identity authentication, include {{c1::Authentication=Active Directory Managed Identity;}} in DAB's connection string.
column2:
Omit User ID and Password for the system-assigned identity.
Review source

column1: The GitHub Action for deploying a DAB image to Container Apps is {{c1::azure/container-apps-deploy-action}}.
column2:
It can deploy a prebuilt image or build an image from supplied source.
Review source

column1: Pass an already pushed DAB image to azure/container-apps-deploy-action through its {{c1::imageToDeploy}} input.
column2:
Supply the image's registry address, repository, and tag.
Review source

column1: In Container Apps, the {{c1::Liveness}} probe checks whether DAB is running and responsive.
column2:
Configure a probe path and port that the container actually serves.
Review source

column1: In Container Apps, the {{c1::Readiness}} probe checks whether a DAB replica can handle incoming requests.
column2:
A database-aware readiness check can detect when a required backend is unavailable.
Review source

column1: DAB's comprehensive endpoint for configured data-source and entity health checks is {{c1::/health}}.
column2:
Enable the relevant checks and authorize the probe. Stored procedures are excluded from entity health checks.
Review source

column1: When a Dockerfile declares ARG ENVIRONMENT, select production during docker build with {{c1::--build-arg ENVIRONMENT=production}}.
column2:
The Dockerfile must use the argument to select configuration. Supply database credentials securely at runtime instead.
Review source
